faq.q: What is a titanium connecting rod?
faq.a: A titanium connecting rod is a precision-machined engine component component used in high-rpm engine connecting rod. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium connecting rod?
faq.a: Titanium Connecting Rod is designed for high-rpm engine connecting rod. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium connecting rod manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Connecting Rod is manufactured using Hot forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium connecting rod?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
